Reference / http/method

http/method#

HTTP methods: those of RFC 9110 and PATCH (RFC 5789), and other(name) for an extension token.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

MethodName(Method.put).string();                       // "PUT"
MethodName("GET").method();                            // Method.get
MethodName("get").method();                            // Method.other("get")
MethodSemantics(Method.put).idempotent();              // true

Description#

HTTP methods: those of RFC 9110 and PATCH (RFC 5789), and other(name) for an extension token.

Methods are case-sensitive: "get" is an extension, not GET.

object MethodName#

object MethodName

The token of a method on the wire, and the method of a token. Validation happens at construction without I/O; the later wire framer owns line limits. A standard token always reads back as its own case, so Method.other("GET") is refused.

MethodName.MethodName#

MethodName(token is string)

The method of token; InvalidMethod when it is not a token.

MethodName(method is Method)

The token of method; Method.other("GET") is refused.

The token.

object MethodSemantics#

object MethodSemantics

Conservative protocol observations, never an automatic retry policy or a request-body restriction. Unknown extensions do not acquire standard semantics.
